text.en: Common stair riser at most 0.18 m
text.ru: Подъём ступени общей лестницы не более 0.18 м

source.edition: September 2018 (CDGH-OP-25, 1348 pages), official PDF read from a web.archive.org snapshot of 2025-06-15
source.paraphrase: Exit-stair risers may not exceed 180 mm and may not be below 100 mm.

text.en: Common stair tread at least 0.28 m
text.ru: Проступь общей лестницы не менее 0.28 м

source.edition: September 2018 (CDGH-OP-25, 1348 pages), official PDF read from a web.archive.org snapshot of 2025-06-15
source.paraphrase: Exit-stair tread depth must be at least 280 mm.

text.en: Common stair flight width at least 1.2 m
text.ru: Ширина марша общей лестницы не менее 1.2 м

source.edition: September 2018 (CDGH-OP-25, 1348 pages), official PDF read from a web.archive.org snapshot of 2025-06-15
source.paraphrase: An exit stair serving up to 2000 persons needs at least 1200 mm clear and enough width for the egress capacity.

text.en: Travel distance to an exit or stair at most 30 m (residential)
text.ru: Путь до выхода или лестницы не более 30 м (жилые)

source.clause: Table 3.16 row 6.i (Residential A, apartment main door to exit), p.293
source.edition: September 2018 (CDGH-OP-25, 1348 pages), official PDF read from a web.archive.org snapshot of 2025-06-15
source.paraphrase: Unsprinklered apartment: 30 m from the flat main door to an exit; 61 m when sprinklered.

text.en: Travel distance to an exit or stair at most 61 m (office)
text.ru: Путь до выхода или лестницы не более 61 м (офисы)

source.clause: Table 3.16 row 2.i (Business, regular office areas), p.293
source.edition: September 2018 (CDGH-OP-25, 1348 pages), official PDF read from a web.archive.org snapshot of 2025-06-15
source.paraphrase: Offices without sprinklers: 61 m to an exit; 91 m with sprinklers.
